ablation: remove the cross-sectional volatility-slope dispersion state and deploy the same positive residual-trend ranking every rebalance
allocation: Monday fixed slots min(0.25, 1/K); unused slots cash; strict ineligibility exits persist until next scheduled rebalance
cash_rule: base holds cash unless cross-sectional short/long residual-volatility slopes are both unusually dispersed and expanding
contamination_notes: A-L development evidence and the Ebenezar profile campaign are already observed. Frontier-M is repeated development research, not a fresh holdout. 2023-2024 is spent.
cost_hypothesis: market-state gating plus weekly fixed slots should reduce unnecessary trading; exact ATR-linked ladder is frozen at 0/4/8/12%
failure_mode: slope dispersion is only ordinary return/residual dispersion or a generic risk-on gate with no incremental deployment information
falsifier: invert the slope-dispersion state so the same residual-trend selection deploys during low and contracting term-structure dispersion
nearest_incumbent: hrt_dispersion_switch / breadth timing; distinct information object is cross-sectional dispersion of asset-level short-vs-long residual-volatility slopes
primitive: Quantiacs daily OHLCV and historical is_liquid only
selection: when slope dispersion is above its trailing median and rising, rank positive 21-day residual trend and hold top-K; otherwise cash
selection_objective: minimum research/dev Sharpe across 0.04/0.08/0.12 ATR cost; then worst DD, lower turnover, id
source_notes: New Frontier-M hypothesis registered after L and the completed Ebenezar translation; no Frontier-M return observed before preregistration.
stop_rule: freeze if falsifier or ablation matches/beats canonical base or if every valid base cell is below the fixed 1.0 robust-development floor; do not grid-rescue after failure
thesis: Cross-sectional disagreement in volatility-curve shape may mark periods when asset-specific state transitions are rich enough for residual-trend concentration to be worth deploying.
timing: completed daily bars only; toolbox owns execution lag; all rolling state is causal and <=365 days
validation: 2023-2024 is SPENT_DO_NOT_MUTATE and excluded from Frontier-M selection; 2025+ and live never drive mutation
